testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore the model browser: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:112:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore the model browser ✔ Given a part document is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the model browser is visible at the left of the workspace ✔ When the user opens the User Interface menu from the View ribbon tab ✔ And the user clears the Model Browser option ✔ Then the model browser is hidden ✔ And the viewport extends into the space it occupied ✔ When the user reopens the User Interface menu ✔ Then the Model Browser option is unchecked ✔ When the user selects the Model Browser option again ✔ Then the model browser returns to the left of the workspace ✔ When the user reopens the User Interface menu ✔ Then the Model Browser option is checked
